services:
  public-only:
    image: alpine:3.22
    command: [sh, -c, 'ip -4 route; ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1']
    networks: [public]
  mixed:
    image: alpine:3.22
    command: [sh, -c, 'ip -4 route; ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1']
    networks: [public, private]
  private-only:
    image: alpine:3.22
    command: [sh, -c, 'ip -4 route; ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1']
    networks: [private]
networks:
  public: {}
  private:
    internal: true
